summary: The exact current feature revision is approved for human merge and the deliberate Railway redeployment operation. The integrated change restores only the established ContinuityField-owned containment, canvas/fallback, halo, and label rules removed during stylesheet consolidation; it preserves the approved Clinical Glass / Continuity Aurora direction, public copy and routes, component behavior, contracts, backend, database, and Railway topology. Independent TARGETED evidence and reviewer reruns confirm the production build and all 8 Chromium journeys pass; at 1920x1080 and 390x844 the hero visualization has bounded nonzero geometry, both render surfaces and all four labels remain contained, the document has no horizontal overflow, and public navigation reaches the controlled role gateway. Repository verification PASSED at implementation-and-test commit 9e377d07142af2fa6b9f87248fe56a612818d243, and only the verification report plus a status-only task advance follow it, so that evidence remains current for reviewed commit 2c0e73ec274f84826b5bae2f3a082c2c515b36be. Security review is not required for this LOW-risk presentation-only repair. The live Railway URL still serving the pre-fix bundle is expected because production deployment was intentionally held until final review/merge; exact API/web terminal deployment states, API /health, repaired-bundle identity, and post-deploy browser smoke remain mandatory post-merge operational verification, but are not a defect in the reviewed source revision.
